title: Scientists Discover Stonehenge-like Circle in Denmark
titleZh: 科学家在丹麦发现类似巨石阵的石圈
credits: John Russell adapted this story based on an AFP report.

sentences.en: Danish researchers have announced the discovery of a collection of wooden pieces placed in a circle that are believed to date back thousands of years ago.
sentences.zh: 丹麦研究人员宣布发现了一组呈圆形排列的木块，据信可追溯到数千年前。

sentences.en: The team says the wood pieces and some other objects were found during building work in the northwestern Danish town of Aars.
sentences.zh: 研究小组表示，这些木块及其他一些物品是在丹麦西北部城镇奥尔斯的施工中发现的。

sentences.en: The discovery led the researchers to suggest the people who placed the wooden pieces might have been linked to a group who built Britain’s famous Stonehenge stone structure.
sentences.zh: 这一发现使研究人员推测，放置这些木块的人可能与建造英国著名巨石阵石结构的人群有关联。

sentences.en: A total of 45 ancient wood pieces were discovered underground last week during building, or construction, work.
sentences.zh: 上周在施工过程中，人们共在地下发现了45块古代木块。

sentences.en: The pieces formed a circle about 30 meters across.
sentences.zh: 这些木块组成了一个直径约30米的圆圈。

sentences.en: In an email to the French news agency AFP, Sidsel Wahlin of the town’s Vesthimmerlands museum described the discovery as “a once in a lifetime find.”
sentences.zh: 该市韦斯特希默兰博物馆的希德斯埃尔·瓦林通过一封给法国法新社（AFP）的电子邮件，将这一发现称为“一生难遇的发现”。

sentences.en: The circle "points to a strong connection with the British henge world," she added.
sentences.zh: 她还表示，这个圆圈“表明与英国巨石阵文化有着密切联系”。

sentences.en: The British Museum says on its website the first stones placed at Stonehenge, in southern England, are believed to have started arriving there around 3000 BC.
sentences.zh: 大英博物馆在其网站上表示，位于英格兰南部的巨石阵最早放置的石头据信大约在公元前3000年开始运抵此地。

sentences.en: The Danish researchers said they were also looking to see whether an inner circle might also exist where the wooden pieces were found.
sentences.zh: 丹麦研究人员表示，他们还在考察木块被发现处是否还存在一个内圈。

sentences.en: Wahlin noted that in the past, other wood circles had been found on the Danish island of Bornholm in the Baltic Sea.
sentences.zh: 瓦林指出，过去在波罗的海上的丹麦博恩霍尔姆岛上曾发现过其他木圈。

sentences.en: But Wahlin said the circle in Aars was "the first one of this larger type that we can properly investigate.”
sentences.zh: 但瓦林说，奥尔斯的这个圆圈“是我们能够进行彻底研究的首个这种较大类型的木圈”。

sentences.en: Archeologists working at the building site also found an ancient settlement that included a leader’s grave and a bronze sword.
sentences.zh: 在该建筑工地工作的考古学家还发现了一处古代聚落，其中包括一位首领的墓葬和一把青铜剑。

sentences.en: Wahlin said her team was still carrying out detailed work in the area in an effort to estimate the age and purpose of the materials.
sentences.zh: 瓦林说，她的团队仍在该地区开展细致工作，以评估这些材料的年代和用途。

sentences.en: In particular, the archeologists are now searching for religious-connected materials known as "ritual deposits."
sentences.zh: 特别是，考古学家现在正在寻找与宗教相关的、被称为“祭祀供奉”的物品。

sentences.en: These might include flint arrow heads and small knives or daggers.
sentences.zh: 这些物品可能包括燧石箭头和小刀或匕首。

sentences.en: Wahlin said the researchers will continue looking for links between the Aars site and other groups, such as those who built Stonehenge.
sentences.zh: 瓦林说，研究人员将继续寻找奥尔斯遗址与其他群体（如建造巨石阵的群体）之间的联系。

sentences.en: She added the influence of other groups had already been found in some objects and graves found in Denmark.
sentences.zh: 她还表示，其他群体的影响已在丹麦发现的一些物品和墓葬中被找到。

glossary.def: a kind of circular Bronze Age structure
glossary.zh: 石阵 (n.): 圆形巨石建筑; 史前环形石构遗迹
